audience: employers who plan staff rotas, shifts and time off in WorkSchedule.Net

useCases.title: Find the users, locations and departments
useCases.text: List the users of the company with their role and department. List the Locations, Areas or Departments to get the IDs for a shift.

useCases.title: Read a shift or time-off block by its ID
useCases.text: Read one time block from the Schedule or Attendance calendar by its ID or external ID. Look up the assigned user to see who works it.

useCases.title: Post a new shift or an open shift
useCases.text: Create a shift or time-off block for a user, or an open shift with no user. The block is written to the live schedule.

useCases.title: Change the time, user or notes of a shift
useCases.text: Change the user, times, notes, colour or category items of one block. Only the fields you send change.
